subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord add a default-off `autoMentionReply` policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on replies, or should native Discord replies plus explicit/alias mentions remain the supported notification model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds notification policy and new config surface in a stable Discord channel, so automation should not choose the product semantics or default alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

options.title: Keep current notification model
options.body: Leave native Discord replies and explicit or alias mentions as the supported behavior, then document that OpenClaw does not synthesize visible reply-author mentions.

options.title: Defer for live design proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a live multi-bot Discord reproduction and expected notification transcript before accepting new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, tests, and live guild proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current mention alias path and is the strongest history signal for the Discord notification/config decision.
